name: @opencraw/captcha-tesseract
description: An image-captcha reader for OpenCraw's form captchas: Tesseract (WebAssembly, bundled English model, nothing fetched at run time) reads the code, a read of the wrong length or with an unsure character is refreshed instead of submitted, and every read can be audited with the page's verdict.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --packages=external --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.esm.js --sourcemap && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --declarationDir dist/src --tsBuildInfoFile dist/src/tsconfig.lib.tsbuildinfo && node ../../declaration-specifiers.mjs dist/src
